## Description

A cylindrical face of radius R is offset inward by exactly R. The offset surface collapses to the cylinder axis (a line) — no surface remains. Bug-reporter language: "offset collapses to axis", "offset surface degenerate", "offset distance equals radius".

## Reproducer recipe

A cylinder of radius 5 mm. Request inward offset of 5 mm.

## Expected kernel behavior

Detect the degenerate case; emit a "result is the axis" diagnostic; refuse to produce a face.

**Structured outcomes** (extracted from prose; for downstream auto-grading):
- allowed: `reject`

Synonyms: "axis collapse offset". **See also**: Os003.
